news.headline: Iran attacks US base in Jordan, ships near Hormuz after tankers sunk
news.body: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said it fired ballistic missiles at a U.S.-used base in Jordan and struck ships near the Strait of Hormuz after U.S. forces said they destroyed five Iranian oil tankers. The exchanges represent a sharp escalation in the months‑long conflict, pushing oil prices higher and prompting regional and international concern.
